signal: Olo went private in a $2B Thoma Bravo deal in 2025, acquired Spendgo, and is launching the Olo Network and consumer app

email.body1:
Jennifer, saw Olo went private with Thoma Bravo, acquired Spendgo, and is building toward the Olo Network and a consumer app.

A pivot that big usually means more emerging-enterprise brands in play than the team can cover before reps learn the new story, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Olo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jennifer, quick follow-up for Olo.

Under new ownership, the emerging-enterprise target usually grows faster than the team can cover. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Olo's emerging-enterprise segment needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jennifer, last bit of proof for Olo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Olo's reply rate likely compares to other restaurant-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jennifer, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling emerging-enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A take-private and a new network launch are their own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an emerging-enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Olo either way.
